name: Rocket.Chat Adapter
description: Development preview: relay direct WhatsApp text messages to Rocket.Chat Omnichannel and agent text replies back to WhatsApp.
author: yederlv

baseUrl.title: Rocket.Chat origin
baseUrl.description: HTTPS origin of Rocket.Chat. For the documented local Docker lab only: http://rocketchat:3000.

sessionId.title: WhatsApp session ID
sessionId.description: Exact OpenWA session UUID. Bind the ingress instance to this same session.

department.title: Omnichannel department
department.description: Optional Rocket.Chat department name or ID used when registering visitors. Changing it creates a new mapping namespace.

es.name: Conector Rocket.Chat
es.description: Vista previa: conecta mensajes de texto privados de WhatsApp con agentes de Rocket.Chat Omnichannel.

baseUrl.title: Origen de Rocket.Chat
baseUrl.description: Origen HTTPS de Rocket.Chat. Solo en el laboratorio Docker documentado: http://rocketchat:3000.

sessionId.title: ID de sesión de WhatsApp
sessionId.description: UUID exacto de la sesión OpenWA. Vincula la instancia de ingreso a esta misma sesión.

department.title: Departamento Omnichannel
department.description: Nombre o ID opcional del departamento de Rocket.Chat. Cambiarlo crea un espacio de asociaciones nuevo.

zh-CN.name: Rocket.Chat 连接器
zh-CN.description: 开发预览：将 WhatsApp 私聊文本与 Rocket.Chat 全渠道客服连接。

baseUrl.title: Rocket.Chat 源地址
baseUrl.description: Rocket.Chat 的 HTTPS 源地址。仅限本地 Docker 实验环境：http://rocketchat:3000。

sessionId.title: WhatsApp 会话 ID
sessionId.description: OpenWA 会话的完整 UUID。入口实例必须绑定同一会话。

department.title: 全渠道部门
department.description: 可选的 Rocket.Chat 部门名称或 ID。修改后使用新的映射空间。
